summary: Trinity Biotech plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the launch of Trinovium, a new subsidiary focused on supplying healthcare-grade fluid technology to the AI data center liquid cooling market. The filing describes the strategic initiative, leveraging existing manufacturing capacity, but provides no specific terms, pricing, premium, or timeframe typical of a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event. The announcement is a business expansion press release, not a corporate event requiring classification under special-situations categories.
